logline: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.

moments.description: Gerald steps forward to mock Juliana, calling her a discarded bride.
moments.key_dialogue: A penniless nobody for a discarded bride.

moments.description: Clarissa cruelly taunts Juliana about her perceived worthlessness.
moments.key_dialogue: You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are.

moments.description: The Mysterious Bearded Man gives a resolute answer when Juliana asks why he would offer her his name.
moments.key_dialogue: Because I know what I see.

moments.description: The Mysterious Bearded Man firmly assures Juliana that his marriage proposal is a solemn vow rather than pity.
The Priest nervously asks Juliana if she is certain about marrying the scarred stranger.
Juliana stands tall and fires back at Gerald, choosing her own life over begging.
moments.key_dialogue: ...than spend another moment begging for yours.

moments.description: Lady Ashcroft angrily disowns Juliana and forbids her from ever returning to Ashcroft Manor.
